# Yusheng Intelligent Technology

> Manufacturer of intelligent precision machining equipment: CNC lathes, turn-mill
> centres, drilling and tapping centres, automatic load/unload systems, robots and
> custom special-purpose machines. Built for production turning and milling of shafts,
> discs, housings and complex parts in automotive, electronics, mould, aerospace and
> medical applications. Site available in English and Chinese.

## Products

- [CNC Lathes](https://yusheng-intelligent.pages.dev/product-cnc.html): High-rigidity slant-bed turning centres for shafts, discs and complex parts, with fast turret indexing and optional bar feed.
- [Turn-Mill Centres](https://yusheng-intelligent.pages.dev/product-turnmill.html): Multi-axis machines that mill, drill and turn in one set-up — one clamping, complete machining, tighter tolerances.
- [Drilling & Tapping Centres](https://yusheng-intelligent.pages.dev/product-drilling.html): High-speed machining centres for batch drilling, tapping and light milling on 3C, electronics and connector parts.
- [Auto Load/Unload Systems](https://yusheng-intelligent.pages.dev/product-auto.html): Gantry loaders, pallet changers and bar feeders for unmanned shifts and higher machine utilization.
- [Robots & Manipulators](https://yusheng-intelligent.pages.dev/product-robot.html): Articulated and gantry robots for loading, unloading, palletizing and in-line material handling.
- [Custom Special Machines](https://yusheng-intelligent.pages.dev/product-custom.html): Dedicated machines engineered around a specific part, process and floor layout.
- [All products](https://yusheng-intelligent.pages.dev/products.html): Overview of the six product families.

## Applications

- [Applications](https://yusheng-intelligent.pages.dev/applications.html): How the machines are applied in automotive, electronics, mould and hardware, aerospace and medical device manufacturing.
